sections.description: The Purple is a fresh take on the classic game of tag. Explore alien landscapes, collect unique artifacts, and avoid The Purple infection! In a unique twist, players are never truly eliminated. Spectators can affect the gameplay, and sometimes even rejoin the game. With many maps, settings, advancements, and more, there is always something new to discover.

images.caption: Affect the game as a spectator

sections.title: How to Play
sections.intro: Outlast the competition and be the last player standing if you want to win in "The Purple". Tired of winning? Collect all the artifacts, unlock all the advancements, and become the best fisher on the planet!

categories.name: Avoid the infection
categories.body: "The Purple" itself is an infection that can be passed from player to player. Tag someone to get rid of The Purple and give it to them!

categories.name: Survive the round
categories.body: The player (or players!) with The Purple at the end of the round will be corrupted and become a spectator! But worry not, you are not out of the game yet.

categories.name: Collect Powerups
categories.body:
There are many powerups that can help you out in your gameplay; they spawn randomly around the map. Store up your powerups for later, or use them right away

[icon:icons/clock.png] Freeze the timer or escape in a [icon:icons/smoke_bomb.png] cloud of smoke. Block an extra attack with the [icon:icons/safety_vest.png] Safety Vest or reveal players with the [icon:icons/goat_horn.png] Glow Horn. You can even revive dead players with the [icon:icons/revival_elixir.png] Revival Elixir. There are many powerups to try out, each with their own addition to the gameplay.

categories.name: Infected Abilities
categories.body: Got infected? Get rid of it as soon as possible! But fret not, you have your own ability now to help you. Increased reach, Invisibility, a Burst of Speed; select one of many Infected Ability options while in the lobby so you are prepared when the pressure is on.

categories.name: Spectators can play too
categories.body: Spectators have abilities too! It's part of what makes The Purple so unique. Use your spectator abilities to affect gameplay: Spawn power-ups, Teleport players, Spawn hordes of annoying purple slimes, and more!

categories.name: Collect Artifacts
categories.body: Artifacts are hidden throughout the game and can be collected by players. Artifacts glow when you get close to them. Click to pick them up, and display them on pedestals in the lobby. Some artifacts are easy to find, while others may need to find you.

sections.title: Abilities
sections.body:
There are two different types of abilities in The Purple: Spectator Abilities and Infected Abilities. Infected Abilities are meant to assist you while you are infected. Spectator Abilties give you something to do when you are dead, and can influence the game in strategic ways or just simply to have some fun.

You may only have one ability of each type selected at any given time. To select an ability, open your inventory while in the lobby and click on the icon of the ability you want desire. You can change your ability at any time while in the lobby. In game you will see the ability you have selected via the item name on your hotbar.

To use your ability, right click on the item in your hotbar. If you are in spectator mode, you can use your ability via left click.

Abilities have a cooldown, and will deactivate early if you become no longer infected.

faqs.question: What are abilities and how do I select them?
faqs.answer:
Spectator Abilities Infected Abilities

While in the lobby, open your inventory to view all the abilities. Your inventory works as a selection menu: click around to select your abilities. Read more about abilities in the Abilities section of this page.

faqs.question: Help! I'm stuck in spectator mode!
faqs.answer:
Use the command ++/trigger return++.

As a spectator you can fly around an affect the gameplay, but if you want to get back in, you'll need to run the command to return to the game. There is also a message in chat from when you entered spectator mode. You can click that in case you forget the command.

faqs.question: Why am I sometimes in the game and sometimes spectator mode after dying?
faqs.answer: Once you end a round as infected, you become a spectator. Spectators have two modes, and can swap between the two interchangeably. Both modes allow you to use your spectator ability to continue to affect the game, but one mode allows you to fly around the map as a spectator, and the other one will have you looking like other players but dead, which can allow you to get back into the game with a Revival Elixir.

faqs.question: What does my team color mean?
faqs.answer: The color of your nametag indicates your status in the game. Green for alive in game, purple for infected, or gray for a spectator. Players also have colored stars in front of their names that indicate their selected cosmetic color. This affects the color of your footprints, the color of wool that appears when you spread infection, and the color of your space helmet. Cosmetic team color has no gameplay effect.

faqs.question: How do I know who is infected?
Why would I want to revive someone?
faqs.answer: A couple reasons! Firstly, its just a fun game with some friends, so why not! There is however some strategy to it as well. If you are infected with no alive players nearby, you may want to revive a nearby spectator to pass on The Purple and help your chances of winning.
